"""
分布式任务队列接口
目标：解耦任务生产与消费，支持长时间运行
"""
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Optional
from enum import Enum

class TaskStatus(Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    RUNNING = "running"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"
    RETRY = "retry"

@dataclass
class Task:
    id: str
    payload: Any
    status: TaskStatus = TaskStatus.PENDING
    retries: int = 0
    created_at: float = 0.0
    started_at: Optional[float] = None
    completed_at: Optional[float] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None

class ITaskQueue(ABC):
    """任务队列抽象接口"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def enqueue(self, task: Task) -> bool:
        """入队任务"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def dequeue(self) -> Optional[Task]:
        """出队任务（阻塞）"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def mark_completed(self, task_id: str, result: Any) -> bool:
        """标记任务完成"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def mark_failed(self, task_id: str, error: str) -> bool:
        """标记任务失败"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskStatus]:
        """查询任务状态"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def size(self) -> int:
        """队列大小"""
        pass

class TaskQueueConfig:
    """任务队列配置"""
    def __init__(
        self,
        max_retries: int = 3,
        retry_delay: float = 5.0,
        visibility_timeout: float = 300.0,
        batch_size: int = 10
    ):
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
        self.visibility_timeout = visibility_timeout
        self.batch_size = batch_size

"""
资源管理器接口
目标：统一管理内存、文件句柄等资源，防止泄漏
"""
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from contextlib import contextmanager
import threading

@dataclass
class ResourceUsage:
    memory_mb: float = 0.0
    open_files: int = 0
    threads: int = 0
    cpu_percent: float = 0.0

class IResourceManager(ABC):
    """资源管理器抽象接口"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def register(self, name: str, resource: Any) -> str:
        """注册资源"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def acquire(self, name: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        """获取资源"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def release(self, name: str) -> bool:
        """释放资源"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def get_usage(self) -> ResourceUsage:
        """获取当前资源使用情况"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def force_cleanup(self) -> int:
        """强制清理未释放资源，返回清理数量"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    @contextmanager
    def managed(self, name: str, resource: Any):
        """上下文管理器方式管理资源"""
        try:
            self.register(name, resource)
            yield resource
        finally:
            self.release(name)

class ResourceManagerConfig:
    """资源管理器配置"""
    def __init__(
        self,
        max_memory_mb: float = 4096.0,
        max_open_files: int = 1000,
        gc_frequency: int = 300,
        auto_cleanup: bool = True
    ):
        self.max_memory_mb = max_memory_mb
        self.max_open_files = max_open_files
        self.gc_frequency = gc_frequency
        self.auto_cleanup = auto_cleanup

"""
GC优化器接口
目标：减少内存垃圾，优化垃圾回收策略
"""
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
import gc

@dataclass
class GCMetrics:
    collection_count: int = 0
    collected_objects: int = 0
    memory_freed_mb: float = 0.0
    duration_ms: float = 0.0

class IGCOptimizer(ABC):
    """GC优化器抽象接口"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def optimize(self, aggressive: bool = False) -> GCMetrics:
        """执行优化"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def register_pool(self, name: str, pool: Any) -> None:
        """注册对象池"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def get_metrics(self) -> GCMetrics:
        """获取GC指标"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def suggest_collection(self) -> bool:
        """建议是否执行GC"""
        pass

class ObjectPool(ABC):
    """对象池抽象接口（减少GC压力）"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def acquire(self) -> Any:
        """获取对象"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def release(self, obj: Any) -> None:
        """释放对象到池中"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def clear(self) -> None:
        """清空池"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def size(self) -> int:
        """当前池大小"""
        pass

class GCOptimizerConfig:
    """GC优化器配置"""
    def __init__(
        self,
        threshold_mb: float = 100.0,
        auto_collect: bool = True,
        generation_target: int = 2,
        debug: bool = False
    ):
        self.threshold_mb = threshold_mb
        self.auto_collect = auto_collect
        self.generation_target = generation_target
        self.debug = debug
